description: Candidate DBSCAN realignment after fine-time voxel settings over-fragmented trajectories. Uses proper T3PA fine timestamps: time_ticks = ToA - FToA / 16. Compared with the fine-voxel setting, time is allowed to bridge about 10 fine FToA bins per distance unit and eps is widened to reconnect visually continuous tracks.
notes: Candidate only; not yet a frozen Phase 2 teacher.
Supersedes the eps=2.5 aligned-time candidate because visual inspection showed fine bins 8350464000..8350489600 were one particle but still split into 8 labels.

On crowded file 08_thu_proton_daily_batch/toa_tot__r0000007293.t3pa, the visual-one 40 us slab at fine bins 8350464000..8350489600 changes from 8 non-noise labels and 5.0% noise under eps=2.5 to 1 label and 0.0% noise.
On the same file, the earlier visual-five 40 us slab at fine bins 3846784000..3846809600 remains 5 labels, with noise reduced from 4.3% under eps=2.5 to 1.9%.
On the same full file, particle count changes from 76331 with the fine-voxel DBSCAN candidate to 11399; noise fraction changes from 0.373 to 0.007.
Needs multi-file continuity and merge-risk audit before being used for Phase 2 training data.

params.time_axis: ToA - FToA / 16 in 25 ns tick units
